name: @deepsea/local-model-supervisor
description: DeepSea plugin: local model servers (AFM, llama.cpp, …) hosted by DeepSea itself: started when a session selects or uses their provider, reused across sessions and variants, adopted when already running, stopped once idle and unused.

deepsea.machineWide: local model server processes it starts and stops (by default afm on 127.0.0.1:9997)

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check supervisor.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
